model_system: 2D square-lattice metallic d-wave altermagnet with intrinsic spin-singlet superconductivity

key_params.Hamiltonian: H0 = sum_{k,σ}[ξ_k - σ(t_am/2)(cos kx - cos ky) + σB] c†_{kσ} c_{kσ} + pairing
key_params.form_factors: γ(k)=cos kx + cos ky, η(k)=cos kx - cos ky
key_params.pairing_channel: spin-singlet with Δ_k^Q = Δ_d^Q η(k) + Δ_s^Q γ(k)
key_params.field: in-plane Zeeman field B with μ_B = 1, no orbital effect
key_params.Q_search: solve self-consistently for fixed Q, then minimize ground-state energy over Q; use uniaxial Q along x-axis so Q=(Q,0)

headline_claim: At zero magnetic field, a finite-momentum FF superconducting phase appears for d-wave pairing in the range 0.44 ≲ t_am ≲ 0.56.
replication_difficulty: medium — requires self-consistent BdG/BCS mean-field plus global minimization over finite pair momentum on a dense 1000×1000 grid.
